get.summary: Read the local bilingual service catalog
get.description: Public projection only. No custom distributed quota. An absent or empty lang selects en; an unsupported non-empty value returns 400. This envelope differs from the stage-3 proposed array.

example.error: lang must be en or ar

post.description: Quantity, whole-USD budget and supplier B warranty only. Supplier A fixed at USD 1200/unit, 24 months; B at USD 1180/unit. No supplier verification, order creation, authenticated approval or persistence. Missing Origin is accepted; cross-origin Origin is rejected. Handler checks streamed size, not only Content-Length. No custom distributed rate limit.

example.policy: Compare prices only after warranty and budget checks; a responsible person must decide.

403.description: Present Origin header does not equal request URL origin

415.description: Content-Type does not start with application/json

405.description: Unsupported method, including GET. Framework-generated; no custom JSON error shape is guaranteed.

get.summary: Verify both configured keys against the owner-selected Supabase project
get.description: GETs /auth/v1/settings with the publishable key and /rest/v1/ with the secret key (REST root rejects publishable keys); no table rows read or written. Pins xsyxvswbiptbyxyqhdim.supabase.co and refuses redirects. Never returns keys or upstream response bodies. Five-second timeout per request, no-store. HTTP 200 only if both keys authenticate; 503 for missing/invalid configuration, wrong project, denied access or network failure. Does not prove schema, RLS or application workflows. Response includes safe diagnostic enums only: project (ok/missing/invalid); publishableKey and secretKey (ok/missing/invalid_format/rejected/unreachable/not_checked). No variable values or upstream response bodies.

supabaseSession.name: sb-xsyxvswbiptbyxyqhdim-auth-token
supabaseSession.description: HttpOnly Supabase SSR session cookie; large values may be split into numbered .0/.1 cookies. Send the complete cookie jar issued by register/login. Server getUser validates identity; data RLS also checks the active session. Never fabricate a cookie or treat email confirmation as proof of email ownership.

agentKey.description: Server-to-server key scoped to one published agent; hash stored, revocable, 90-day expiry.

widgetSession.description: Public-source-only widget token, expires in ten minutes; publication generation checked on every call.
